name: GCP emulators
tagline: Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage state for local GCP emulators — and the same config runs against real Google Cloud.
highlights: same config runs against real Google Cloud

features.title: Topics, subscriptions, buckets
features.body: Idempotent provisioning of Pub/Sub topics and subscriptions and Cloud Storage buckets.

features.title: Drift reconciliation
features.body: Sends a minimal update mask: only the fields that actually changed.

features.title: Fixed-at-creation fields
features.body: Fields Pub/Sub fixes at creation (filter, enable_message_ordering) are reported as warnings instead of failing the run.

features.title: Emulator gaps
features.body: Gaps in the emulators that Google Cloud does not have are downgraded to warnings, so one config works against both.

features.title: Dry run
features.body: Previews every mutation against live state.

features.title: Never destructive
features.body: Never deletes topics, subscriptions or buckets that are not in the config.
